test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

They are playing songs so ______ that the entire neighbourhood is disturbed.
solution: The correct answer is: **Loud** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • "**Loud**" means producing or capable of producing much noise; easily audible; having a great volume. (बहुत अधिक शोर उत्पन्न करने वाला या उत्पन्न करने में सक्षम; आसानी से सुनने योग्य; बड़ी मात्रा में होना) • **For example**: *The thunder was so loud that it startled the children.* • In the given sentence, the context suggests that the songs are being played at a high volume, disturbing the entire neighbourhood. • "Loud" is an adjective, and it modifies the noun "songs" in the sentence. • The comparative form of "loud" is "louder", and the superlative form is "loudest". Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**. **Complete sentence**: *They are playing songs so loud __that the entire neighbourhood is disturbed. * [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • "**Lord**" is a noun that refers to a person who has power or authority over others, especially a feudal superior. (ऐसा व्यक्ति जिसके पास दूसरों पर शक्ति या अधिकार हो, विशेषकर किसी सामंती श्रेष्ठ पर) • "**Loved**" is the past tense and past participle form of the verb "love", which means to have a strong affection or liking for someone or something. (किसी व्यक्ति या वस्तु के प्रति गहरा स्नेह या पसंद होना) • "**Laud**" is a verb that means to praise someone or something highly, especially in a public context. (किसी व्यक्ति या वस्तु की अत्यधिक प्रशंसा करना, विशेषकर सार्वजनिक संदर्भ में) 1bc:T9e4, The correct answer is: **She was distributing the cards to her friends.**
